hook_card.text:
هبطتي فالميزان… وطلعو الخطوط؟
ماشي الريجيم… السبب تحت الجلد

shots.vo_line: أنا الميزان ديالك. نقصتي 15 كيلو، وفرحنا بجوج. ولكن نهار لبستي السروال
shots.row: A cute pink bathroom scale with a smiling face on its display, the thigh character standing on it, confetti
shots.h3_prompt: The scale talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures while opening its eyes and waving its tiny arms. The thigh character bounces on the scale pumping her fists, then keeps swaying her hips in a happy little dance as the scale bobs under her and confetti keeps drifting down. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.

shots.vo_line: القديم وطاح عليك، شفتك كتشوفي فخدك وجنبك… خطوط حمرين وبيضين. وسكتّي.
shots.row: The thigh character holding huge old jeans, looking at her lines; the scale's face turns sad
shots.h3_prompt: The scale talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures while wringing its tiny hands and slowly shaking its head. The thigh character lets go of the loose jeans and they slide down to her sneakers; she looks down at the lines on her thigh, touches them, and keeps sagging with quiet sighs and slow blinks. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.

shots.vo_line: ماشي أنا السبب، وماشي الريجيم. ملي زدتي قبل بالزربة، الجلد تجبد وتقطع من لتحت. وملي نقصتي، رخا وبانو
shots.row: The scale's display showing a mini animation of skin stretching and threads snapping
shots.h3_prompt: The scale talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures while shaking its head with both palms raised. Inside its window the pink threads stretch tight and snap one by one with tiny sparks as the scale flinches. Then the layers slowly sag loose and wavy while the scale keeps explaining with worried eyes and small bounces. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.

shots.vo_line: الخطوط. وزدتي فالرياضة… الرياضة كتشد العضلات، ماشي الجلد. دهنتي الكريمات… كيبقاو
shots.row: The thigh character exercising, then rubbing cream on herself, then scrubbed by a coffee bowl; the scale shaking its head
shots.h3_prompt: The three small scales talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures while slowly shaking their heads. The left thigh character starts bouncy squats; then the middle one rubs cream in slow circles on her hip, and both keep going while the right pair only blink and sway. Static camera. shots.vo_line: فوق. حكيتي بالقهوة… حمّرتي الجلد. كلشي كان من برا، والجرح من لتحت.

Then all three thigh characters look down at their lines and keep sagging sadly, breathing and blinking. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. shots.frame_issue: Same frame as s04: double pink shorts on every thigh character (off-model vs C7).

shots.vo_line: أنا نقدر نعطيك الرقم… ولكن اللي يوصل لتحت الجلد هو غوتيفا. سيروم خفيف، الجلد كيشربو كامل.
